notice.title: Protection from explicit pornography
notice.description: Protection combines official metadata, title-and-poster analysis, and manual decisions. Keep enforcement focused on explicit pornography—not mature content in general, reader identity, or orientation.

automatic.title: Automatic pornography detection
automatic.description: OpenAI analyzes the title and poster once. Decisions are cached to prevent duplicate checks.
automatic.cacheNotice: The poster URL is sent to the moderation service; posters remain blurred here by default.
automatic.disabledNotice: The statuses and counts below reflect cached AI assessments, but they no longer block titles and no new OpenAI calls are started. Metadata rules and manual decisions remain active.

allow.title: Allow this title?
allow.description: The manual decision will override the AI assessment for {{title}}. Metadata and other content-policy rules still apply.

block.title: Block this title?
block.description: {{title}} will be blocked immediately for new reader and translation checks.

restore.title: Restore the AI decision?
restore.description: The manual override for {{title}} will be removed and the latest automatic decision will apply.

backfill.title: Analyze recent history?
backfill.description: Up to 50 stored manga visits without a current assessment will be queued. Existing cached decisions will not be duplicated.

checklist.title: Blocked official metadata
checklist.description: Review discovered genres, tags, categories, rating, and content rating values. Checked values block chapter translation.
